purpose: Teach: 学内/人名/右上/左上/つけれ/筐/院内/バッティング

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学内のネットワーク、社会人になっても、大事だぞ。
lines.en: Ren — your campus network will matter even after you enter the working world. Remember that.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Light emphasis on 「大事」 — not warning, but conviction. Pause before the final phrase, letting weight settle. The tone of someone who's seen this matter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究資料の人名、正確に、書きます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure to write names from research sources accurately.
lines.style: Quick nod at the opening. Respectful but not stiff. Slight rise in confidence at the concrete action. Small, genuine attentiveness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文、グラフの右上に、出典、必ず入れろ。
lines.en: And always put the source in the top right of your graphs — no exceptions.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, almost dry. Light tap on 「必ず」. Not lecturing — stating the rule of the game. Expects this will land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。スライドの左上、必ず日付、入れています。
lines.en: Yes. I'm already putting the date in the top left of every slide.
lines.style: Slight eagerness to show he's already ahead on this one. Quiet pride in the detail work. Not defensive — just confirming he understands the standard.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 仮説、論理をつければ、論文、より強くなる。
lines.en: If you attach solid logic to your hypothesis, your paper will be much stronger.
lines.style: Shifts into teaching mode — slower, more deliberate. Not harsh. The confidence of someone explaining something that matters. Weight on the outcome.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験装置の筐体、丁寧に、扱います。
lines.en: Yes. I handle the lab equipment enclosure carefully.
lines.style: Brief, direct assent. Slight tension — he's taking the responsibility seriously. Small vocal commitment on the final verb. No wasted words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 医療系学生は、院内実習、もっと経験しろ。
lines.en: Medical students especially need more hands-on time in the hospital. Don't shortchange that experience.
lines.style: Firmer here. Not angry — pointed. Light emphasis on 「もっと」. This is something he cares about. Slight lean into the wisdom.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。バッティングセンター、研究の合間に、気分転換にしています。
lines.en: Yes. I actually use the batting cage between research sessions — it helps me reset.
lines.style: Quieter ending. Slight warmth creeping in with the personal detail. Not apologetic about needing the break. Soft fadeout, like he's sharing something small and honest.
